name: Eyeless Jack
description: Eyeless Jack is a fictional character from internet creepypasta fiction, depicted as a figure in a black hoodie and blue mask with empty, black-fluid-leaking eye sockets who breaks into homes to harvest and eat human organs — particularly kidneys.
origin: As an internet-based fictional character, Eyeless Jack has no geographic distribution in the traditional sense. The character circulates globally through English-language and translated creepypasta communities.
